evaluation_methodology: out-of-sample time-split: MLE refit on first half of post-warmup matches, evaluated on second half. Baseline coefs are static (no refit). Honest because the MLE has never seen the eval matches.

in_sample_full_fit_metrics_for_reference.note: Coefs in /opt/jarvis-app-1/scripts/wc2026_predictor_dc_mle.json are the full-sample MLE fit (all 451 post-warmup matches). Those coefs ARE NOT evaluated here — the OOS comparison above uses the train-half-only fit to keep the eval honest.

honest_note: OOS time-split: train on first 225 post-warmup matches, evaluate on the remaining 226. Paired bootstrap (n_boot=300). Brier delta 95% CI [-0.1116, +0.0188]; winner delta 95% CI [-9.08pp, +0.44pp]. Real-lift Brier=False, real-lift winner=False. Recommendation: reject. 'Adopt' requires BOTH 95% CIs to strictly exclude 0 in the favourable direction (Brier delta < 0, winner delta > 0).
